purpose: isolated hoist keep/drop experiment, not accelerated-adoption acceptance or an Orca scoreboard
job: supports-off Benchy Arachne, unchanged frozen-job settings in benchy-arachne.json
order: AB then BA, alternating by pair; ordinary batch then accelerated batch
exactness: prove both mode-specific pairs before timing; every later output must equal its proved fresh baseline byte-for-byte

starvation.reference_group: mode and arm separately; serial-work removal changes the ratio between arms
starvation.discard: the whole pair if either member is below its arm cutoff; retain all excluded rows; no automatic resampling

keep: in both modes: lower candidate median wall with lower candidate median process CPU; paired median deltas must agree; otherwise return DROP/inconclusive to the human
disclosure: SHA-256, bytes, TYPE counts, generator, status, degraded/fatal/non-fatal counts, existing open-loop warnings, and every sample cpu/wall ratio
